purpose: Discovery of B2B configuration software, not suppliers of physical products

protocol.session: Fresh conversation per response; ChatGPT Temporary + Unpersonalized; Perplexity Incognito
protocol.location: Europe/Bucharest browser context; actual engine retrieval country and exact model version may be unknown
exclude: Follow-up answers in the same conversation
protocol.unknown: null, never false or zero; only completed controlled samples enter denominators
protocol.success: Valid distinct human contacts and suitable opportunities, not mention rate alone
protocol.privacy: Keep observations, private account URLs and commercial metrics in ignored website/outputs; no PII or account history
protocol.interpretation: Report numerator and denominator for each prompt/engine/condition. Three runs are a directional pilot, not a representative market share or causal growth result. Do not pool languages or report unrun prompts as zero.
protocol.attribution: Use consent-observed GA4 source/medium and hostname, then reconcile qualified contacts with private inbox/vendor aggregates. Probe responses do not measure leads. GSC beta AI impressions do not measure all ChatGPT/Perplexity citations.
